findings.finding: Patients with hypertension + obesity (BMI > 30) have 31% higher 10-year cardiovascular event probability.
findings.recommendation: Discuss statin therapy review with your cardiologist.

findings.finding: Patients with atrial fibrillation on warfarin whose INR was checked at least monthly had 27% fewer strokes than those checked less often.
findings.recommendation: Ask your GP how often your INR is checked while you take warfarin.

recommendations.action: Keep INR checks at least monthly while you take warfarin.
recommendations.basedOn: Atrial fibrillation + anticoagulation pattern (n=1,912 across EHDS SPEs)
